title: active-record-v1
description: L1 active-memory projection rendered on-demand by cdad_continuity.py resume; it is never persisted (O1) and never embeds a transcript (P7/D2).

authority.description: HITL delegation read from the execution context or, when absent, from the structured state (D4); expired authority reconstructs context but never authorizes effects. `state` is the CURRENT vigencia, evaluated at read time (never frozen stale in the L2 body).

state.description: active/current when the delegation is in force; expired when revoked or past; unknown when no reliable signal exists.

decisions.description: Frozen decisions, each WITH its rationale (D11).

changes.description: 007-003 (§2.5/§2.6): the changes the writer DECLARED in the body being projected. Empty list when the body declares none (a legacy body is never rewritten and nothing is inferred from references, decisions or logs).

evidence.description: 007-003 (§2.5/§2.6): the evidence of the projected body with its EXPLICIT applicability. An `invalidada` entry keeps its identity (reference untouched), its reason and its antecedent; it is never presented as current accreditation. Empty list for a legacy body.

antecedent.description: The traceable antecedent of the applicability: null, or the body and evidence it refers to (same chain).
